metadata.source: VED recorded ICE trip, 2017-11-01 week; longest continuous part of published de-identified GPS trajectory
metadata.target_provenance: MAF + bank-1 short/long fuel trims; estimated observed gasoline L/h
metadata.expected_provenance: Fitted ridge baseline using speed, RPM, load and RPM×load from other ICE vehicles; scale calibrated on first four minutes of this drive

model.target_assumptions: E10 stoichiometric AFR 14.08 (VED paper); gasoline density 0.749 kg/L from US DOE AFDC reference fuel. Estimated fuel, not direct measurement.
model.validation_warning: One-week subset, estimated target, provisional detector; not validated for real faults.
